# Conceptual, illustrative only
def epsilon_greedy_action(q_network, state, epsilon=0.1):
    if np.random.rand() < epsilon:
        return np.random.choice([-1, 0, 1])  # explore
    return np.argmax(q_network.predict(state)) - 1  # exploit

# DQN: learn Q(state, action), act greedily on it
# Policy-gradient: learn the policy directly, no Q-function
caption: Q-learning/DQN estimates expected future reward per action; policy-gradient methods learn the action-choosing policy directly.
